comment: Seed-sweep declaration consumed by generate_one.py / make_manifest.py / collect.py. Session name = <prefix>_seed<NN>. noise_seed_base = noise_seed_offset + noise_seed_step * topology_seed (recorded in every network npz). space_size scales as sqrt(num_clusters/50) so neuron density stays ~constant across cluster counts. build_overrides are explicit build_network kwargs that WIN over state defaults; noise_weight=0.007 is the flagship operating point (dataset_generation.ipynb / MODEL_CHARACTERIZATION.md), NOT the registry default 0.004.
